---
output: pdf_document
---
```{r}
library(knitr)
df <- data.frame(A = 1:6, Subteste = c("DC", "DC", "DC", "IMe", "IMe", "IMe"), Val = 1:6)
calc_linesep <- function(df, col = "Subteste") {
  ls <- ifelse(df[[col]][-1] == df[[col]][-nrow(df)], "", "\\hline")
  c(ls, "")
}
kable(df, format="latex", booktabs=TRUE, linesep=calc_linesep(df))
```
